title: 第4183章 离开九州第4182章 诛仙出世
content_zh:
九州。
这一日，诛仙起剑，圣贤出世。
人间每一个角落，几乎都可以感受到那股无与伦比的威压，惊天动地，神鬼辟易。
中原上空，那漫天飞雪在停滞了一瞬后，再度片片落下，夜色下，整个中原，举目望去，一片银装素裹，美丽异常。
李园，众人瞩目中，一老一少两道身影从中原走出。
这一次，人族圣贤不再像先前只有一道投影，而是真正拿回了所有的一切，隐约可见，圣贤周围，空间法则都在扭曲，远远望去，一片朦胧。
前院，众人看到道门圣贤真身现世，纷纷俯下身，恭敬行礼。
而在东院中，东方、白夜等五位魔主看着外面的人族圣贤，立刻停止了交谈，略微低头，以示礼节。
倒不是五位魔主刻意装样子，本来，魔族就信奉实力为尊，纵然人族圣贤非是魔族，但是，还是赢得了五位魔主的敬意。
“夫君。”
前院，离别在即，朱珠看着眼前将要离开的夫君，神色动容地叮嘱道，“早去早回，你现在可是成过亲的人了，出门在外，一定要记得，家中还有人在等你回来！”
“好。”
近在咫尺，李子夜面露温和之色，轻声应道，“在李园等我。”
一旁，太商听过眼前一对新人的道别之语，开口承诺道，“朱珠丫头放心即可，有老朽在，没人能动这小子。”
“多谢前辈。”
朱珠看向夫君身旁的老人，目光微黯，说道，“前辈也要好好保重。”
太商闻言，笑了笑，告别道，“走了。”
话声落，太商没有再多说什么，非常洒脱地朝着外面走去。
后方，李子夜迈步跟上，一同离去。
众人之间，早已失去常羲意识的鬼刹女看着李园外逐渐远去的老人，眼角处，不知为何，一滴泪水无声淌下，落地成霜。

“大师兄。”
这一刻，众人前方，常昱注视着李教习和太商前辈离去的背影，轻声问道，“我们会赢吧？”
“当然！”
一旁，白忘语毫不犹豫地回答道，“对此，我从未怀疑！”
十步外，文修儒背靠在一块还未清理走的假山巨石前，目光不在意地看了一眼黑夜尽头的两人，平静的神色不见丝毫波澜。
成大事者，当真是先要将自己逼疯。
“小子夜。”
西行的路上，太商看着西境上空的天门，开口提醒道，“你的伤势不轻，此去南天门那边，你什么都不要做，只负责养伤，明白吗？”
“明白。”李子夜点头应道，
黑夜中，一老一少一路前行，看似不紧不慢，实则速度极快，每一步迈出，身影都会凭空消失不见，再出现时，已至黑夜尽头。
没过多久，中原西境，南天门前的荒野上，一老一少两人相继走至。
天门下，齐聚于此的各方强者看到来人，短暂的震惊后，赶忙上前行礼。
content_en:
Kyushu.
On this day, Zhu Xian raised his sword and the sage was born.
In almost every corner of the world, one can feel the unparalleled pressure, which is earth-shattering and the gods and ghosts are changing things.
Over the Central Plains, the flying snow fell again after stagnating for a moment. Under the night, the entire Central Plains was covered with silver, which was extremely beautiful.
Li Yuan, in the center of everyone's attention, two figures, an old man and a young man, walked out of the Central Plains.
This time, the human sage no longer only had a projection like before, but actually took back everything. It was vaguely visible that the laws of space around the sage were distorted, and it looked hazy from a distance.
In the front yard, everyone saw the true form of the Taoist sage appearing, and they all bent down and saluted respectfully.
In the east courtyard, Dongfang, Bai Ye and other five demon lords looked at the human sages outside, immediately stopped talking and lowered their heads slightly to show courtesy.
It's not that the five demon lords are deliberately pretending. Originally, the demons believed in strength. Even though the human sages were not demons, they still won the respect of the five demon lords.
"Husband."
In the front yard, parting was about to take place. Zhu Zhu looked at her husband who was about to leave in front of her, and told her with a moving expression, "Go early and come back early. You are now married. When you go out, you must remember that there are still people at home waiting for you to come back!"
"Okay."
Being so close, Li Ziye showed a gentle look on his face and responded softly, "Wait for me in Li Garden."
On the side, Taishang listened to the farewell words of the newlyweds in front of him and promised, "Don't worry, little Zhu Zhu, no one can touch this kid as long as I'm here."
"Thank you, senior."
Zhu Zhu looked at the old man beside her husband, her eyes darkened slightly, and said, "Senior, you should also take good care of yourself."
Upon hearing this, Taishang smiled and said goodbye, "Let's go."
After finishing speaking, Taishang didn't say anything more and walked outside very casually.
From behind, Li Ziye followed up and left together.
Among the people, Gui Shanu, who had long lost Chang Xi's consciousness, looked at the old man who was gradually retreating outside Li Garden. For some reason, a drop of tear silently fell down from the corner of his eyes and turned into frost on the ground.
"Big Brother."
At this moment, in front of everyone, Chang Yu watched the departing figures of Li Jiaoxi and Senior Taishang, and asked softly, "Will we win?"
"Of course!"
On the side, Bai Wangyu replied without hesitation, "I have never doubted this!"
Ten steps away, Wen Xiuru leaned against a rockery boulder that had not yet been cleared away. He glanced at the two people at the end of the night casually, his calm expression showing no signs of wavering.
To achieve great things, you really have to drive yourself crazy first.
"Xiao Ziye."
On the way to the west, Taishang looked at the Tianmen in the sky above the Western Territory and reminded him, "Your injury is not serious. If you go to the Nantianmen, you don't have to do anything but recuperate. Do you understand?"
"Understood." Li Ziye nodded and responded,
In the dark night, an old man and a young man walked forward, seemingly unhurriedly, but in fact they were extremely fast. With every step they took, their figures would disappear out of thin air, and when they reappeared, it would be at the end of the night.
Not long after, in the western border of the Central Plains, in the wilderness in front of the Nantian Gate, two people, an old man and a young man, came one after another.
Under the Tianmen, the strong men from all walks of life gathered here saw the person coming. After a brief shock, they hurried forward to salute.
